text:
alana: Hey team — need a compact field-ready brief (1 pager + 1 slide) that ties together security, SLA guarantees, and deployment options for enterprise buyers. Target: SOC2/CISO audience + platform leads. Launch assets due next Tue. Thoughts?

mike: Quick ask — can we include a micro-benchmark vs. our typical hosted latency/cost numbers? customers always want that. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

sanjay: yes, benchmark is critical. Keep it high level: p50/p95 latency for chat gen, tokens/sec, and cost per 1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated vs private. call out caching and batching benefits.

tess: For sales, we need 3 hero value props: predictable SLAs, deploy anywhere (hosted/dedicated/private), and cost controls. Short bullets + a single customer testimonial line would help.

alana: agree. Messaging options: A) "Deploy with Confidence: Secure, Predictable LLM Inference" B) "Enterprise Inference: SLAs, Security, and Flexible Deployment" — prefer shorter. Open to other phrasing.

katie: can draft 1-pager copy. I'll lead on the exec blurb. Suggest CTA variants: "Request a security brief" / "Get a custom SLA estimate" / "Schedule a compliance review"

mike: inbound routing note — tag leads by intent: security/compliance, performance/latency, cost. If "security" tag present, route to AE + solutions SE + security SME. If "performance" -> performance team. Add an ops ticket template.

ops-bot: deploy checklist created: https://internal/redwood/checklists/enterprise-brief-template (placeholder) :white_check_mark:

alana: For the benchmark narrative, keep 1 concrete table row example: 1) Hosted (gpt-ish open model) p95 280ms, cost $X per 1k tokens. 2) Dedicated (reserved) p95 120ms, cost $Y. 3) Private on-prem p95 180ms, cost $Z, with encryption/KMS note. Call out fallback behavior and routing policies.

sanjay: Add a short callout about quality parity — same model weights across modes, minus quantization caveat. Also include a tiny diagram for routing policy: latency-priority -> dedicated, cost-priority -> hosted, compliance -> private.

tess: Webinar hook: "How to Meet Enterprise SLAs for LLMs" — 30 min, 15 min demo (routing + failover), 10 min Q&A. Good to co-host with a customer (if available) and one solutions SE.

mike: Landing flow for webinar signups: capture deploy mode interest, compliance checkbox, region. Route hot leads (enterprise checkbox + large usage) to AE immediately.

alana: Asset list for launch: 1) One-page brief (katie) 2) 1-slide summary + infographic (design) 3) benchmark snapshot PNG (eng) 4) webinar sign-up page copy (growth) 5) inbound routing playbook (ops) 6) short sales email + reply templates (tess)

katie: I'll put the one-pager draft into the shared drive tonight. Will use this headline: "Secure, SLA-backed Inference — Hosted to On-Prem". First paragraph: a 2-sentence problem statement + 3 bullets of benefits.

mike: sales email skeleton: "We help teams keep AI features online and predictable — SLAs, private deployments, and cost controls. Can we run a quick 20 min call to map your needs?" Short, clear.

alana: Quick ask for designers: make sure the "SLA" section visually highlights uptime, P95 latency, and data handling (KMS/HSM). No deep tech docs — link to appendix.

ops-bot: Suggested inbound routing tags: ["security", "sla", "private-deploy", "dedicated", "hosted", "benchmark-interest"] — recommend rules: any message with "private" + "compliance" -> high priority.

sanjay: Evaluation hook: include 3 mini-prompts for customers to repro our bench: short, medium, long contexts. Provide seed prompts and expected latency ranges.

alana: Timeline reminder: preview to sales + SEs Fri AM, final assets Mon EOD, publish Tue. Can folks ack?

tess: ack — I'll prep sales kit and two email templates (intro + webinar follow-up).

mike: ack — I'll get eng bench numbers and a PNG by Monday.

katie: ack — drafting now, will share copy by EOD.

sanjay: ack. I'll add the routing diagram and quick tech caveats.

alana: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble and run a 30-min sync Mon 9am to finalize. If you can't make it, drop comments in the doc. :rocket:
